tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yab rje kun dga' blo gros kyis ljags bsgrigs gzungs grwa lnga'i mngon dkyil las bdag bskyed rkyang pa zur du bkol ba dge/ oṃ swasti/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la༞ /chos la༞ /dge 'dun la༞ /bla ma la sogs nyer gcig bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub ma thob bar du bdag nyid skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis bsgom bzlas bgyis pa'i bsod nams 'di dag gis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur du 'grub par shog /gsum/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ gsum/ rang gi snying ga'i pad dmar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems nyid yi ge praṃ dkar la ser ba'i mdangs chags pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par gyur/ bla ma rnams gcig tu 'dus nas rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs par gyur/ lus kyis phyag 'tshal bar bsam zhing / ngag tu/ bla ma rnams dang rje btsun so sor 'brang ma dang / stong chen rab 'joms de bzhin rma bya chen mo dang / gsang sngags rjes 'dzin bsil ba'i tshal gyi lha mo rnams/ 'khor dang bcas la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhes brjod cing / thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa rak+ṣa de ba tsakra maṇ+ḍa la sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pa'i mchod yon dang / de bzhin du/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ gis zhabs bsil/ puṣ+pe me tog dhū pes bdug spos/ ā lo kes mar me/ gan+dhes dri/ nai wi d+yas zhal zas/ shap+tas rol mos phul la/ bla ma dang ni lha mo lnga yi sku rnams la/ /me tog dag dang spos la sogs pas mchod par bgyi/ /lus dang ngag dang rab tu dwangs ba'i sems kyis ni/ /rnam mang sdig pa bgyis pa dag ni 'chag bgyis shing / /de dag rnams la skyabs su nye bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul che dang ldan pa de dag la/ /lha gang mngon par rab tu dang ba yod pa yi/ /lha de mgu zhing yid ni rab tu dga' gyur nas/ /rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis bdag la bsrung du gsol/ /zhes brjod la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ tshogs rten gyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bya/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar bya/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang dus rtag tu mi 'bral bar bya/ bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring mtha' dag dang bral nas chags sdang med pa'i ngang la sems btang snyoms par bya/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzña na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus dkar ba/ lte bar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og tu rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs rnams su rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng du rdo rje'i gur/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i bla bre/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i drwa ba/ phyi nas ye shes kyi me bskal pa 'jigs pa'i me phung lta bu 'bar bas bskor ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang du/

yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can sngon po/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sor po/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog gi gnas gru bzhi pa/ lcogs brgyad kyis mdzes pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+rūṃ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rtsig pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i steng na/ rin po che'i snam bu ser po/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ de'i steng du chu srin ma ka ra'i kha nas 'phyangs ba'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa/ de'i steng du bya 'dabs las 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu dkar po/ de'i steng du kra ma shir+ṣa pad+ma'i 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can/ phyi rol nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po bzhis bskor ba'i steng du/ mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas 'dzin pa sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rdo rje rin po ches brgyan cing / rtse mo rdo rje dang nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ shar gyi pad 'dabs kyi steng du raṃ las nyi ma/ gzhan rnams kyi steng du a las zla ba'i gdan re re/ dbus kyi zla ba'i steng du/ praṃ dkar la ser ba'i mdangs chags pa/ shar du hūm̐ sngon po/ lhor maṃ ser po/ nub tu shaṃ dmar skya/ byang du gaṃ ljang gu/ sa bon gyi yi ge de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ mchog sbyin/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya rnams sa bon gyi yi ge de dag gis mtshan par gyur/

de rnams las kyang 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bsrung ba lnga'i lha tshogs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ so so'i sku yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus su rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo sku mdog cung zad dkar ser/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i rnam pa can/ gtsug tor mchod rten gyis brgyan pa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa/ zhal bzhi ma/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum ma/ phyag brgyad ma rna rgyan 'phyang ba/ mu tig gi do shal dang zhabs la rkang sil dang / rin po che'i ske rags dril bu g.yer kha dang bcas pa/ rtsa zhal cung zad dkar ser/ g.yas nag rgyab ser/ g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas kyi phyag bzhi na 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ mda'/ ral gri/ g.yon bzhi na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ rtse gsum/ gzhu/ dgra satwa 'dzin pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pas spras pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas bklubs pa/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu du mas spras pa'i byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du stong chen rab 'joms sku mdog sngon mo/ nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyangs ste rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal sngon mo/ g.yas dkar/ rgyab ser/ g.yon dmar ba/ dbu re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal la la mche ba gtsigs shing / la la rab tu gdangs nas ljags 'dril ba/ smin ma'i dbus na khro gnyer bsdus pa/ g.yas kyi phyag bzhis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ ral gri/ g.yon bzhi na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dgra satwa/ gzhu/ pad+ma'i steng na rin po che zur drug pa 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang / rus pa dang rin po che'i gdu bu dang / dpung rgyan dang /

mu tig gi do shal dang / g.yer khas spras pa/ sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa rab tu khros pa drag mo'i tshul can/ tā la'i sdong po rab tu rgyas pa'i shing drung na ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /lhor rma bya chen mo gser gyi mdog can/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal ser mo/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas kyi phyag bzhi na mchog sbyin dang rin po che'i rgyun babs pa'i bum pa/ 'khor lo/ ral gri/ g.yon bzhi na dge slong dang bcas pa'i lhung bzed dang / rma bya'i mjug sgro dang / sna tshogs rdo rjes kha brgyan pa'i bum pa/ rin po che'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan cing / dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas bklubs pa/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol can mya ngan med pa'i shing drung na bzhugs pa'o/ /nub tu gsang sngags rjes 'dzin pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ zhabs skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa gzhon nu dar la babs pa/ zhal gsum phyag bcu gnyis ma/ rtsa zhal dmar/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya/ de 'og gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya/ g.yas kyi phyag lhag ma bzhi na/ mchog sbyin dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / rdo rje mda'/ g.yon gyi lhag ma bzhi na/ sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang bcas pa dang / pad+mas brgyan pa'i bum pa dang / rin po che'i snye ma dang / gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i cod paṇa dang / mgul rgyan dang / gdu bu dang / dpung rgyan dang / mu tig gi do shal dang / rin po che sna tshogs pas spras pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol la brten pa/ shi ri sha'i shing drung na bzhugs pa'o/ /byang du bsil ba'i tshal chen mo margad ltar ljang ba/

zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal ljang gu/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas kyi phyag gsum na/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya/ rdo rje/ mda'/ g.yon gsum na/ zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang / rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang / gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras shing / dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' bklubs pa/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ tsam pa ka'i shing drung na bzhugs pa'o/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/ mgul chings/ kha rgyan dang bcas pa bzhi'o/ /de ltar ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid kyi lha mo lnga'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ snying ga'i nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i sa bon/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du 'dres par gyur/ yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga'i lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣi ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lus ye shes kyi chu rgyun gyis gang / sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin la dbang bar byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsgom mo/ /de ltar lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan gyi/ dbang po'i gzhu lta bu la yid rtse gcig tu mnyam par gzhag par bya'o/ /sgom pas skyo na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa rak+ṣa sogs nyer spyod kyis mchod/

rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid mchog /dung dang kun+da'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /so sor 'brang mar phyag 'tshal bstod/ /kha dog nag mo mi zad 'jigs/ /rngams shing zhal 'gyur khro gnyer can/ /gdul dka'i 'byung po yang dag 'dul/ /rdo rje khro mor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lha mo ye shes las byung che/ /gser gyi 'od ltar rab 'bar ba'i/ /rma bya che la rab dad pa'i/ /rig pa'i rgyal mor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /pad+ma kha phye'i zhal mnga' ba/ /zhal mdzes ma la spyan yangs shing / /pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba'i/ /'gro ba'i mar gyur phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mthing kha nam mkha'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyis sgeg ma/ /dug rnams 'joms par byed pa mo/ /sku mdzes ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod la bzlas pa la 'jug ste/ lha so so'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar so so'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las ma lus pa bsgrub/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa ma lus pa bsdus nas rang nyid la thim par gyur/ las dang mthun pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pas/ sngags bzla ba ni/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi ma hā pra ti sa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ so sor 'brang ma'o/ /oṃ a mṛ ta wa re wa ra wa ra pra wa ra bi shud+dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ stong chen mo'o/ /oṃ a mṛ ta bi lo ki ni gar+bhe saṃ rak+ṣa ṇi ā kar+ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ rma bya chen mo'o/ /oṃ bi ma le bi pu/ dza ya ba re a mṛ ta bi ra dze hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin no/ /oṃ bha ra bha ra saṃ bha ra in+d+ri ya ba la bi sho dha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ru ru tsa le swāhā/ bsil ba'i tshal lo/ /ci 'grub bzlas nas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin lha mo lnga'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la 'jug par mdzad nas/

mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ yig brgya lan gsum/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ srung 'khor gzhal yas khang lha mo bzhi bum pa dang bcas pa rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul che dang ldan pa de dag la/ /lha gang mngon par rab tu dang ba yod pa yi/ /lha de mgu zhing yid ni rab tu dga' gyur nas/ /rab tu dwangs ba'i sems kyis bdag la bsrung du gsol/ /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /srung ba lnga po 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med/ /chos kyi nyi ma rgyas pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi nas/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med/ /dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnam 'phel ba/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /dge 'dun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba/ /rgyal sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /nyon mongs dug lngas gdungs ba'i dgra zhi nas/ /rtag tu dpal༞ /tshangs dang lha dbang srung ma'i byin rlabs dang / /phan mdzad lha yi byin rlabs gnas gyur te/ /dge legs bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur nas/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod pa dag /skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed pas/ /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /'dir ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis/ /rtag tu bden par gsung zhing brdzun med par/ /bden pa de yis deng 'dir bde legs shog /deng 'dir 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig /phyogs dang dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du/ /bkra shis dang bde legs chen pos khyab par gyur cig /dza ya dza ya su dza ya/
